ἀφίημι.g: I send away, release, remit, forgive, permit
ἀφίημι.long: (a) I send away, (b) I let go, release, permit to depart, (c) I remit, forgive, (d) I permit, suffer.
ἀφίημι.sd: an intensive form of , to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow)
ἀφίημι.kj: cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up
ἀφίημι.as:
ἀφ-ίημι,
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc.;]
1.to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), I Co 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Ge 35:18, Hdt., al.), Mt 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Mk 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Mt 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Mt 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296 f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Mt 9:2, Ro 4:7(LXX), I Jo 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative pres. (M, Pr., 119), Mk 2:5, Lk 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Lk 5:23.
2.to leave alone, leave, neglect: Mt 4:115:2415:14, Mk 1:20, 31, Jo 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Mk 7:8; τὸν τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, He 6:1; τ. ὀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Re 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21 f.), Mt 13:3622:22, Mk 8:13, al.
3.to let, suffer, permit: Mt 3:15; c. acc., Mt 3:15, 19:14, al.; c. acc. rei et dat. pers., Mt 5:40; c. inf. pres., Mt 23:14, al.; aor., Mk 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175 f.), seq. ἵνα, Mk 11:16, Jo 12:7; c. subjunct. (M, Pr., 175 f.; Bl., § 64, 2), Mt 7:427:49, Mk 15:36, Lk 6:42 (see further MM, s.v.).

ἀφανίζω.g: I cause to disappear, I hide, remove, disfigure
ἀφανίζω.long: I cause to disappear, hide, remove; I disfigure (probably by leaving unwashed for a long period), destroy.
ἀφανίζω.sd: to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed)
ἀφανίζω.as:
ἀφανίζω,
(< ἀφανής), [in LXX for שׁמם ni., שׁמד hi., etc.;]
1.to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., al.).
2. Later (MM, s.v.),
(a)to destroy: Mt 6:19, 20;
(b)to disfigure: Mt 6:16. Pass., to vanish: Ja 4:14; to perish: Ac 13:41(LXX).†

ἀφορίζω.g: I rail off, separate, place apart
ἀφορίζω.long: I rail off, separate, place apart.
ἀφορίζω.sd: to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc.
ἀφορίζω.as:
ἀφ-ορίζω,
[in LXX (Cremer, 805 f.) for בּדל hi., סגר hi., נוף hi., רום hi etc.;]
(a)to mark off by boundaries from, separate from: c. acc., Ac 19:9, Ga 2:12; id. seq. ἐκ (ἀπό), Mt 13:4925:32 (MM, s.v.); of excommunication, Lk 6:22. Pass., absol., II Co 6:17;
(b)to set apart, devote to a special purpose (seq. εἰς): c. acc., Ga 1:15. Mid., Ac 13:2, Ro 1:1 (DB, iii 588).†

ἀφεδρών.sd: a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy
ἀφεδρών.der: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);
ἀφεδρών.as:
*† ἀφεδρών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(cf. ἄφεδρος, Le 12:5) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, s.v.),
a privy, drain: Mt 15:17, Mk 7:19 (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).†

ἄφεσις.long: a sending away, a letting go, a release, pardon, complete forgiveness.
ἄφεσις.as:
ἄφεσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀφίημι), [in LXX for יוֹבֵל, דְּרוֹר, etc. (v. Deiss., BS, 98 ff.; MM, s.v.);]
1.dismissal, release: Lk 4:18.
2. Metaph., of sins (never in LXX), pardon, remission of penalty: ἁμαρτιῶν, Mt 26:28, Mk 1:4, Lk 1:773:324:47, Ac 2:385:3110:4313:3826:18, Col 1:14; παραπτωμάτων, Eph 1:7; absol., Mk 3:29, He 9:2210:18 (cf. DB, ii, 56; DCG, i, 437, ii, 605; Cremer, 297 f.).†
SYN.: πάρεσις, q.v. (and cf. Tr., § xxxiii).

ἀφαιρέω.as:
ἀφ-αιρέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX (Cremer, 615 f.) for סור, עבר, רום, כּרת, etc. (35 words in all);]
to take from, take away, take off: c. acc., τὸ ὠτίον, Mt 26:51, Mk 14:47 (ὠτάριον, WH), Lk 22:50 (οὖς); ὄνειδος, Lk 1:25; seq. ἀπό, Re 22:19, Lk 16:3 (mid.); pass., c. gen., Lk 10:42; ἀ. ἁμαρτίος, He 10:4, Ro 11:27 (mid.) (MM, s.v.).†

ἀφροσύνη.long: want of sense, foolishness, impiety, wickedness.
ἀφροσύνη.as:
ἀφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(< ἄφρων), [in LXX for אִוֶּלֶת, נְבָלָה, etc.;]
foolishness: Mk 7:22, II Co 11:1, 17, 21.†

ἀφρίζω.sd: to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy)
ἀφρίζω.as:
* ἀφρίζω
(< ἀφρός),
to foam at the mouth: Mk 9:18, 20.†

ἄφθαρτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5351 (φθείρω);
ἄφθαρτος.as:
** ἄ-φθαρτος, -ον
(< φθείρω), [in LXX: Wi 12:118:4*;]
imperishable, immortal;
(a) of things: I Co 9:25, I Pe 1:4, 233:4;
(b) of persons: of men, I Co 15:52; of God, Ro 1:23, I Ti 1:17 (MM, s.v.).†

ἀφόβως.der: adverb from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5401 (φόβος);
ἀφόβως.as:
ἀφόβως,
adv.
(< φόβος), [in LXX: Pr 1:33 (מִפַּחַד), Wi 17:4*;]
without fear: Lk 1:74, Phl 1:14, I Co 16:10, Ju 12.†

ἀφίσταμαι.g: I lead away, seduce, depart, abstain from
ἀφίσταμαι.long: I make to stand away, draw away, repel, take up a position away from, withdraw from, leave, abstain from.
ἀφίσταμαι.sd: to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc.
ἀφίσταμαι.kj: depart, draw (fall) away, refrain, withdraw self
ἀφίσταμαι.as:
ἀφ-ίστημι,
[in LXX for סור, מעל, etc. (41 words in all);]
1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaph., to move to revolt: Ac 5:37.
2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., to stand off, depart from, withdraw from: c. gen., Lk 2:37; seq. ἀπό, Lk 4:1313:27, Ac 5:3812:1015:3819:922:29, II Co 12:8; metaph., ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, II Ti 2:19; ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away, apostatize), He 3:12. Mid. (exc. 1 aor., wh. is trans.), to withdraw oneself from, absent oneself from: Lk 2:37; metaph., fall away, apostatize: absol., Lk 8:13; c. gen., I Ti 4:1 (MM, s.v.; Cremer, 308).†

ἀφυπνόω.sd: properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber
ἀφυπνόω.der: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G5258 (ὕπνος);
ἀφυπνόω.as:
**† ἀφ-υπνόω, -ῶ
(< ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: Ge 28:11*;]
1.to awake from sleep (Anth.).
2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, s.v.), to fall asleep: Lk 8:23.†

ἄφρων.sd: properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving
ἄφρων.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5424 (φρήν);
ἄφρων.as:
ἄφρων, -ον gen. -ονος
(< φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל, etc.;]
without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind" (Hort; cf. MM, s.v.): Lk 11:4012:20, Ro 2:20, I Co 15:36, II Co 11:1612:6, 11, I Pe 2:15; opp. to φρόνιμος, II Co 11:19; to συνιέντες, Eph 2:17.†

ἄφαντος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5316 (φαίνω);
ἄφαντος.as:
* ἄφαντος, -ον
(< φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, s.v.),
invisible, hidden: Lk 24:31.†

ἄφνω.as:
ἄφνω,
adv.,
[in LXX for פִּתְאֹם;]
suddenly: Ac 2:216:2628:6.†

ἀφελότης.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot);
ἀφελότης.as:
*† ἀφελότης, -ητος, ἡ
= cl. ἀφέλεια (v. MM, s.v.),
simplicity: Ac 2:46.†

ἄφωνος.sd: voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning
ἄφωνος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5456 (φωνή);
ἄφωνος.as:
ἄφωνος, -ον
(φωνή), [in LXX: Is 53:7 (אלם ni.), Wi 4:19, II Mac 3:29*;]
dumb, speechless: Ac 8:32(LXX); of idols (MM, s.v.), I Co 12:2; of beasts, II Pe 2:19; τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν καὶ οὐδὲν ἄ.—so many kinds of voices and none voiceless, i.e. without signification, unintelligible: I Co 14:10.†

ἄφιξις.as:
** ἄφ-ιξις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀφικνέομαι), [in LXX: III Mac 7:18*;]
in cl. usually, arrival; rarely, departure: Ac 20:29 (so in π., cf. MM, s.v.; M, Pr., 26, n.).†

ἀφθαρσία.as:
**† ἀφθαρσία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἄφθαρτος), [in LXX: Wi 2:236:19, IV Mac 9:2217:12*;]
incorruptibility, immortality: Ro 2:7, I Co 15:42, 50, 53, 54, II Ti 1:10; ἀγαπώντων . . . ἐν ἀ., Eph 6:24 (v. AR, in l.).†

ἀφορμή.long: (a) a starting, a start, (b) cause, occasion, opportunity.
ἀφορμή.der: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G3729 (ὁρμάω);
ἀφορμή.as:
ἀφ-ορμή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX: Ez 5:7 (הָמַן), Pr 9:9, III Mac 3:2*;]
prop., a starting point; in war, a base of operations; metaph., an occasion, incentive, opportunity (MM, s.v.): II Co 11:12, Ga 5:13; ἀφ. λαμβάνειν, Lk 11:24, WH, mg., Ro 7:8, 11; ἀφ. διδόναι, II Co 5:12, I Ti 5:14.†

ἀφικνέομαι.long: I arrive at, reach, come to.
ἀφικνέομαι.der: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G2425 (ἱκανός);
ἀφικνέομαι.as:
ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι,
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc.;] perfective of ἱκνέομαι,
to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaph. (MM, s.v.), Ro 16:19.†

ἁφή.long: a band, fastening (hence, possibly: a ligament), joint.
ἁφή.as:
ἁφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, freq. in Le;]
a joint (MM, s.v.): Eph 4:16, Col 2:19 (Lft., in l.).†

ἀφοράω.long: I look away from (something else) to, see distinctly.
ἀφοράω.as:
ἀφ-οράω, -ῶ,
[in LXX: IV Mac 17:10 (είς θεόν)*;]
(a)to look awayfrom all else at, fix one's gaze upon: metaph. (MM, s.v.), He 12:2;
(b) simply, to see: ἀφίδω (v.s. ἀπεῖδον, and Lft., Phl., in l.; MM, s.v.), Phl 2:23 (v. Ellic., in l.).†

ἀφειδία.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5339 (φείδομαι);
ἀφειδία.as:
* ἀφειδία (L, -εία), -ας, ἡ
(< ἀφειδής, unsparing);
1.extravagance.
2.unsparing treatment, severity: Col 2:23.†

ἀφιλάργυρος.kj: without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre
ἀφιλάργυρος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5366 (φιλάργυρος);
ἀφιλάργυρος.as:
*† ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος, -ον,
without love of money, not avaricious; I Ti 3:3, He 13:5. (For other instances, v. MM, s.v.)†

ἀφιλάγαθος.g: not loving that which is good
ἀφιλάγαθος.long: not loving that which is good.
ἀφιλάγαθος.kj: despiser of those that are good
ἀφιλάγαθος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5358 (φιλάγαθος);
ἀφιλάγαθος.as:
*† ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον,
without love of good: II Ti 3:3 (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but v. MM, s.v.).†

ἀφθορία.as:
† ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ,
(< φθείρω), [in LXX: Hg 2:18, (17) (שִׁדָּפוֹן)*;]
uncorruptness: Tit 2:7 (Rec. ἀφθορία).†

ἀφανής.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5316 (φαίνω);
ἀφανής.as:
ἀφανής, -ές
(< φαίνω), [in LXX: Ne 4:8 (2), Jb 24:20, Si 20:3041:14, II Mac 3:34*;]
unseen, hidden: He 4:13.†

ἀφομοιόω.as:
** ἀφ-ομοιόω, -ῶ,
[in LXX: Wi 13:14, Ep. Jer 5, 63, 71*;]
to make like: pass., He 7:3.†

ἀφανισμός.as:
ἀφανισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἀφανίζω), [in LXX chiefly for שַׁמָּה, שְׁמָמָה;]
vanishing: He 8:13.†

ἀφυστερέω.as:
† ἀφ-υστερέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX: Ne 9:20 (מנע), Si 14:14*;]
1. as in cl., to be late (Polyb., Si 14:14).
2. Trans., to keep back (Ne 9:20; v. Mayor, Ja., 157 f.): pass., Ja 5:4 (MM, s.v.).†
